blurb: Six Byrd Cider Co creates craft ciders ranging from dry to semi-sweet, bridging the gap between wine and beer. Guests can enjoy a variety of ciders on draft and a food menu including bar bites, pizzas, and desserts. The venue hosts events and private parties, offering a casual spot to taste local ciders and food.
